input.quote: 9.8 Any Party shall have the right to review or audit the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9. In affording the right to review or audit, any such Party whose records are being reviewed or audited shall be permitted to recover, from the Party or Parties requesting the review or audit, the entire costs reasonably incurred in complying with the review or audit.
input.rationale: Subparagraph 9.8 gives any Party (including the other APCN 2 Parties) an open-ended right to review or audit our books, records, vouchers and accounts of costs, with no frequency limit and no notice requirement; Subparagraph 9.9 only routes the exercise through the F&ASC's procedures, which are not part of the Agreement and set no notice or frequency floor. Unlimited and unannounced audits fail the fallback on two material terms. Cost allocation is already better than the fallback, because the audited Party recovers its entire compliance costs from the requesting Party without any underpayment exception, so we left that mechanic and the reciprocal nature of the right untouched and added only the once-per-year cap and fifteen (15) days' prior notice.

proposal.summary: Add once-per-year frequency cap and 15 days' prior notice to the Paragraph 9 review/audit right
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 9 lets any Party review or audit our books at will and with no notice, so we added the playbook fallback limits: no more than once per year and at least fifteen (15) days' prior notice. Cost allocation already sits in our favour under Subparagraph 9.8, so we left it untouched.

ops.text: Any right of review or audit pursuant to this Paragraph 9 may be exercised with respect to a Party no more than once per year and only upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior notice to the Party whose books, records, vouchers, and accounts are to be reviewed or audited.

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once per year.
Vendor must give at least 15 days' notice of an audit.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 10 percent.
mappings.quote: any such Party whose records are being reviewed or audited shall be permitted to recover, from the Party or Parties requesting the review or audit, the entire costs reasonably incurred in complying with the review or audit
